\section{Lists}
\label{sec:lists}

\begin{itemize}
  \item A bullet at the first level.
  \item Another one, long enough that it has to be broken across more than a
        single line so that the hanging indent is visible.
  \begin{itemize}
    \item A nested bullet, which LaTeX sets with an en dash.
  \end{itemize}
\end{itemize}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item The first numbered item.
  \item The second, with a second footnote\footnote{Footnotes are numbered
        across the whole document.} attached.
\end{enumerate}

\begin{description}
  \item[Term] A description item, whose term runs into the first line.
\end{description}

\subsection{Verbatim}

\begin{verbatim}
function compile(files, entrypoint) {
  return renderPdf(buildPages(...));
}
\end{verbatim}

\subsubsection{The deepest level}

\texttt{article} numbers no further than this.

\newpage

\section{After a page break}

This section starts on a fresh page.
